$comment_remotes: The HOSTED remote endpoint — one-click OAuth, no API key to paste. OAuth-protected, so NO headers block here: clients negotiate auth via the MCP OAuth flow (RFC 9728 discovery at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp) at connect time. This is the registry counterpart of the npx/mk_live `package` path above; consumers pick whichever they prefer.

mcpb.name: mnemoverse-memory
mcpb.longDescription: Mnemoverse gives your AI assistant long-term memory that persists across sessions and across tools, and learns from outcomes: tell it a recalled memory helped or misled, and it re-ranks what comes back next. Store preferences, decisions, and lessons with memory_write; recall them by natural-language search with memory_read; share a memory pool with other agents through rooms. The same memory is shared everywhere you use your Mnemoverse account — Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and any MCP client. The server starts and lists its tools without a key; every tool call needs a free API key from https://console.mnemoverse.com.
